We value the different perspectives our people bring and recognise everyone for their contributions equally. </p><p>We also know that different people have different priorities, which is why we’re here to support you with whatever you need.  </p><p>We offer hybrid working which involves 3 days per week being office/site based. This position is based in our Epsom, Peterborough or Cambridge offices.</p><p></p><h2>Your role</h2><p></p><p>The role will offer a challenging and rewarding opportunity to apply knowledge, experience, and problem-solving skills whilst providing good opportunities for career development.</p><p>As a Principal Waste Water Process Engineer in the D&amp;AT practice, you would have the following responsibilities:</p><ul><li>Coordinate or manage members of a team of Process engineers for delivery of technical design work on small to complex multi-disciplinary projects following relevant national and project specific design codes and standards, and to high-quality levels in all areas of waste water treatment process and principles – conventional and advance treatment technologies.</li><li>Responsible for producing and reviewing technical deliverables such as design reports, process calculations, process control philosophies, etc.</li><li>Work independently with minimal technical guidance.  Exercise personal judgement to solve difficult problems where appropriate and provide guidance to junior team members.</li><li>Provide technical input into project design deliverables for Process aspects of complex multi-disciplinary projects and work, with the project management team, to successfully manage time and budgets to key project milestones and programmes.</li><li>Collaborate with stakeholders at all levels, including internal and external clients, operational staff, project teams, or external stakeholders. This would include stakeholders within your immediate team and other related AtkinsRéalis teams, as required by the projects you work on.</li><li>Provide mentorship to less experienced colleagues and help to grow the Process Engineering capabilities within the process team.</li><li>Provide technical support for bid proposals.</li><li>Work closely with and within a multi-disciplinary team in the UK and overseas, as per project requirements, to deliver integrated design solutions.</li><li>Adhere to quality assurance standards in design including check and review of your own work as well as others.</li></ul><p></p><h2>About you</h2><p></p><p>The ideal candidate would be a well-rounded and versatile individual who exemplifies the following key skills and attributes:</p><ul><li>Chartered or Incorporated Engineer, preferably IChemE or CIWEM.</li><li>A degree in Chemical Engineering or equivalent (e.g. Environmental, Water and Waste water engineering, etc.).</li><li>Strong knowledge of and design experience in waste water treatment processes and principles: preliminary, primary, secondary, tertiary, quaternary treatment, sludge treatment and understanding of integrated principles and services including emissions, odour, carbon and energy management.</li><li>Practical knowledge of current design codes and standards as well as industry best practices, including CDM Regulations.</li><li>Experience of design and delivery of projects with adherence to UK safety and environmental regulations, process safety techniques (e.g. HAZOP), knowledge of capital and operational costs - and risk assessments, as well as whole life carbon assessments.</li><li>Proven experience in leading elements in treatment process design and integrating elements as part of an existing or new treatment process.</li><li>Proven experience in leading, coordinating or managing people in a Process engineering design delivery team for a project, as part of a design consultancy including within a multi-disciplinary environment.</li><li>Takes a broad perspective to identify innovative solutions to design problems.</li><li>Ability to work independently with minimal technical guidance.</li><li>Demonstrates strong communication skills, with the ability to convey technical concepts clearly and effectively within diverse multi-disciplinary teams.</li><li>A proactive, highly motivated mindset with a collaborative approach to drive teamwork and share success across projects.</li></ul><p>Meet some but not all the criteria?
